title: Version 18.2.2
body_markdown:
Released on **February 10, 2026**.

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed a bug in the MSVC optimizer that caused bad assembly code generation. |  |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE | Descritpion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Github Copilot and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2026-21256**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-21256) | This security update addresses a vulnerability where Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. |
| Github Copilot and Visual Studio Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability | [**CVE-2026-21257**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-21257) | This security update addresses a vulnerability where improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. |
| .NET Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability | [**CVE-2026-21218**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-21218) | This security update addresses a vulnerability where improper handling of missing special element in .NET and Visual Studio allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. |
